title: Wavemill configuration
description: Per-repo (.wavemill-config.json) or user-level (~/.wavemill/config.json) config. All fields are optional; env vars override everything.

configVersion.description: Config format version (e.g., '1.0.0'). Used for upgrade detection and compatibility checks.

modelExclusions.description: Models to remove from default router and challenge candidate pools without hiding newly supported models.

project.description: Linear project name for backlog queries. Empty string means all projects.

terminal.description: Terminal-state resource handling (HOK-2952). Governs how task tmux panes are released once a workflow reaches a terminal reason, independently of git worktree/branch cleanup.

paneRelease.description: Automated pane release for terminal reasons (pr_merged, pr_closed_unmerged, challenge_*). Disabling is the HOK-2952 rollback lever: it stops automated release while truthful state fields, archived transcripts, and terminal records keep being written. The WAVEMILL_TERMINAL_PANE_RELEASE=0 env var overrides this to disabled.

enabled.description: Archive diagnostics, write a durable terminal record, and kill the task pane when a workflow reaches a terminal reason.

startup.description: Startup safety checks before task rehydration and pane creation.

terminalPreflight.description: Reconcile persisted tasks against terminal PR/challenge state before resume menus, launch plans, task panes, or agents are created. The WAVEMILL_STARTUP_TERMINAL_PREFLIGHT=0 env var overrides this to disabled.

enabled.description: When true, terminal persisted tasks are reconciled instead of rehydrated; unverifiable legacy entries are marked verification-required without cleanup.

git.description: Git behavior shared across wavemill workflows.

fetchTtlSeconds.description: Seconds to reuse a successful base-branch fetch before fetching again. Set to 0 to always fetch.

baseBranch.description: Base branch for worktrees and PR targets.

worktreeRoot.description: Directory for git worktrees. Relative paths resolve against the repo root.

agentCmd.description: Agent CLI to use. Built-in support for 'claude' and 'codex'. Other CLIs work via generic tmux passthrough. Can be overridden with --agent flag or AGENT_CMD env var.

requireConfirm.description: Whether to prompt for confirmation before launching tasks.

planningMode.description: How to handle the planning phase. Interactive planning launches a dedicated planning phase in tmux before implementation.

maxRetries.description: Max retry attempts for failed API calls.

retryDelay.description: Initial retry delay in seconds (doubles on each retry).

setupCommand.description: Shell command to run in each new worktree before agent launch (e.g., 'npm install'). Skipped when resuming an existing worktree.

defaultMaxCostUsd.description: Default per-task cost budget guideline in USD. When unset, the built-in default is 25.00. Repository config can still override the value, and omitting the field from routing data means no explicit cost constraint for that run.

expansionHandshake.description: Controls gating of raw-issue-text tasks at the plan→code transition.

policy.description: recover (default): attempt one missing-artifact recovery, then fall back to the bootstrap route if recovery fails. block: halt transition. warn: proceed with a warning log line and skip recovery.

timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for missing expansion artifact recovery. This runs the LLM-backed issue expander and should be longer than short GitHub/Linear API timeouts.

maxSelect.description: Maximum issues that can be selected for expansion.

maxDisplay.description: Maximum candidate issues shown in the selection list.
Maximum initiatives shown in the selection list.

research.description: When true, always run the research phase before plan decomposition. Can be overridden by the --research CLI flag.

model.description: Model selector for plan decomposition and research. Accepts a family alias such as 'opus', 'inherit', or a pinned model ID such as 'claude-opus-4-8'. Can be overridden with PLAN_MODEL env var.

interactive.description: Enable interactive mode for plan decomposition. When true, Claude has access to all tools (WebFetch, AskUserQuestion, Read, etc.) and can fetch URLs, ask questions, and research. When false, Claude runs in non-interactive mode (no tools, pure JSON output). Can be overridden by --interactive or --no-interactive CLI flags.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for plan decomposition and research. Default: 600000 (10 min) for interactive mode, 120000 (2 min) for non-interactive. Can be overridden with PLAN_TIMEOUT env var.

agents.description: Per-phase model selectors for workspace-level routing declarations.

model.description: Model selector for the planning phase. Accepts 'inherit', a family alias (e.g. 'opus'), or a pinned model ID.
Model selector for the coding phase. Accepts 'inherit', a family alias (e.g. 'sonnet'), or a pinned model ID.
Model selector for the review phase. Accepts 'inherit', a family alias (e.g. 'haiku'), or a pinned model ID.

dashboard.description: Controls how much runtime activity is shown in the mill control pane. Lower verbosity reduces dashboard spam while all messages can still be written to a session log.

verbosity.description: Minimum log level shown in the mill control pane. 'error' shows only errors, 'status' shows key workflow transitions, 'info' adds routine progress, and 'debug' shows detailed diagnostic output.

logToFile.description: When true, write all control-pane messages to a per-session log file in .wavemill/logs/ even if they are hidden by the current verbosity setting.

observer.description: Controls the dedicated Backstage Wavemill Observer service. The service is default-disabled and only runs when integration mill-session monitoring is active.

enabled.description: When true, eligible mill sessions launch a dedicated Backstage pane running wavemill observer --loop in detection-only mode.

heartbeatStaleSeconds.description: Seconds after the last observer heartbeat before the Backstage watchdog treats the observer as stale.

maxLogLines.description: Recent mill log lines inspected in each observer pass.

maxSnapshots.description: Reserved limit for retained observer snapshots when snapshot persistence is enabled.

linear.description: Opt-in Observer-to-Linear synchronizer for confirmed, deduplicated incident records.

enabled.description: When true, confirmed incidents can create/update Linear issues. Defaults off for consent gating.

detectionOnly.description: When true, compute planned sync actions but do not write to Linear.

project.description: Linear project id or name used for Wavemill incident correlation and issue creation.

team.description: Linear team id, key, or name used for Wavemill incident routing.

label.description: Optional additional Linear label attached to created/correlated incident issues.

maxIncidentsPerPass.description: Maximum canonical incidents to sync to Linear in one live observer pass.

maxRetryEntriesPerPass.description: Maximum queued incident retries to drain before new live sync work.

requestDelayMs.description: Optional delay before each Linear API request made by incident sync.

rateLimitBackoffMs.description: Optional bounded wait after a Linear 429 before deferring retryable incident sync work.

incident.description: Controls repo-local Wavemill incident detection and deduplicated incident state.

resolutionAfterCycles.description: Consecutive successful observer cycles without a fresh distinct event before an observed/active incident auto-resolves.

emitOsc.description: Opt out of OSC 777 terminal notifications emitted by hook status writes.

taskSelection.description: Controls default task selection behavior in wavemill mill.

enterLaunchesWave.description: When true, pressing Enter launches the planner's first dependency-safe parallel wave instead of the top scored tasks.

backlog.description: Controls backlog rendering in the mill control pane.

maxLines.description: Maximum number of backlog lines to render before truncation rules apply. When omitted, Wavemill derives the budget from the tmux pane height.

defaultAvailableNowCap.description: Default cap for Available Now tasks when the backlog must be condensed.

defaultExpanded.description: Whether grouped backlog rendering starts expanded when truncation would otherwise hide tasks.

focusMilestones.description: Linear project milestone names to boost in backlog scoring.

projectContext.description: Settings for project-context compaction suggestions and behavior.

compactionThresholdKb.description: Size threshold in KB for surfacing project-context compaction suggestions.

recentWorkKeep.description: Number of most-recent Recent Work entries to keep during compaction.

aggregation.description: Cross-repo eval aggregation settings for training the DSPy-optimized model router.

repos.description: Absolute paths to repository directories to aggregate evals from.

outputPath.description: Output path for the aggregated eval file, relative to repo root.

evalsDir.description: Directory for persisting eval result JSONL files. Relative paths resolve against the repo root.

rejectedRetention.description: Maximum number of rejected eval quarantine JSON files to retain under the evals rejected directory.

judge.description: LLM judge configuration for eval scoring.

model.description: Model ID for the eval judge (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-5', 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001').

provider.description: LLM provider for the eval judge. Currently only 'anthropic' is supported.

pricing.description: Per-model pricing table for cost estimation. Keys are model identifiers, values specify cost per million tokens.

inputCostPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million input tokens.

outputCostPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million output tokens.

cacheWriteCostPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million cache creation (write) input tokens. Defaults to 1.25x inputCostPerMTok.

cacheReadCostPerMTok.description: Cost in USD per million cache read input tokens. Defaults to 0.1x inputCostPerMTok.

interventionPenalties.description: Penalty weights per intervention type. Each value is the score penalty (0-1) applied per occurrence of that intervention type.

reviewComment.description: Penalty per PR review comment requesting changes.

postPrCommit.description: Penalty per commit made after the initial PR creation.

manualEdit.description: Penalty per manual file edit (commit not attributed to the agent).

testFix.description: Penalty per interactive test fix detected in commit messages.

sessionRedirect.description: Penalty per user redirection detected in the Claude session transcript (user sent a message correcting the agent mid-session).

selfReviewWarning.description: Penalty per warning-severity finding in self-review (minor issue caught by review-changes tool).

selfReviewBlocker.description: Penalty per blocker-severity finding in self-review (critical issue that blocks PR, such as security vulnerabilities or correctness bugs).

priorFailedAttempt.description: Penalty per failed or aborted prior stage attempt.

unknownAttribution.description: Penalty per commit that could not be attributed to the agent or the operator (no recorded stage-result data).

successThreshold.description: Canonical score threshold used when eval outcomes.success is missing. Defaults to 0.8 when omitted.

postMergeTimeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock timeout in seconds for detached post-merge eval hook processes. Defaults to 600 when omitted.

maxPromptBytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 byte size for an eval judge prompt before failing fast or truncating.

oversizePolicy.description: How eval handles prompts larger than maxPromptBytes.

mintEligibility.description: Coverage gates for minting Wavemill router benchmark results into downstream eligibility-sensitive flows.

enabled.description: When false, disable mint eligibility gating for router eval outputs.

coverageThreshold.description: Minimum scoreable coverage required for mint eligibility. Defaults to 0.8 when omitted.

maxInvalidRouteRate.description: Maximum invalid route rate allowed for mint eligibility. Defaults to 0.2 when omitted.

retention.description: Fixed held-out replay gate for detecting harness regressions before memory rewrites or CI enforcement.

enabled.description: When true, run the fixed harness replay suite. Defaults off until shadow rollout is explicitly enabled.

mode.description: shadow reports D without blocking; enforce fails closed when D exceeds tolerance or replay evidence is invalid.

tolerance.description: Maximum allowed D, where D is baseline-passing cases that fail under the candidate harness. Defaults to 1.

suitePath.description: Path to the committed held-out replay suite manifest, relative to the repo root unless absolute.

reportDir.description: Directory for retained harness replay reports, relative to the repo root unless absolute.

baselineHarnessId.description: Deployed baseline harness ID. May also be supplied by WAVEMILL_BASELINE_HARNESS_ID.

candidateHarnessId.description: Candidate harness ID. May also be supplied by WAVEMILL_CANDIDATE_HARNESS_ID or WAVEMILL_HARNESS_ID.

evalContextUpdates.description: Best-effort post-eval project context and subsystem update settings.

enabled.description: Whether to run post-eval project context and subsystem updates after the eval record is persisted.

timeoutSeconds.description: Per-attempt timeout budget in seconds for best-effort post-eval context updates.

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retries for best-effort post-eval context updates after the first attempt fails.

autoEval.description: When true, automatically run eval after workflow/bugfix command completion (PR creation). Eval failures are logged as warnings and never fail the workflow.

dataSubmission.description: Opt-in configuration for submitting anonymized workflow outcomes to Hokusai.

enabled.description: Enable Hokusai data submission. Defaults to opt-out.

consentVersion.description: Current consent version. Changing this triggers re-prompting.

endpoint.description: Explicit Hokusai endpoint for legacy data submission integrations. Leave unset unless you operate a private submission service.

contributions.description: Durable queue and delivery settings for redacted contribution and benchmark outcome rows.

enabled.description: Enable durable local queueing for redacted contribution rows. Requires valid user consent.

endpoint.description: Explicit endpoint for contribution upload. When null or absent, drain must not attempt upload.

endpointTokenEnv.description: Environment variable containing a bearer token for the contribution endpoint.

batchSize.description: Maximum rows to send in one batch.

exportPath.description: Relative-to-main-repo or absolute path used for manual JSONL export when no endpoint is configured.

maxRetries.description: Maximum retry attempts before moving a transiently failing batch to dead-letter.

backoffInitialMs.description: Initial exponential backoff delay in milliseconds.

backoffMaxMs.description: Maximum exponential backoff delay in milliseconds.

timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout for contribution drain requests in milliseconds.

challenge.description: Settings for challenge mode head-to-head task execution in mill.

enabled.description: Master toggle for challenge mode.

rate.description: Probability that a selected mill task becomes a challenge task.

recommendationRate.description: Probability applied instead of 'rate' when the routing decision carries an exploration challenge recommendation (new-model or low-data-stage). Default 1 launches every recommended challenge when slots allow.

stageWeights.description: Relative weights for which workflow stage a challenge pair varies. Exactly one stage's model differs between primary and challenger. With no weights configured, challenges always vary the implementation (coder) stage, preserving legacy behavior. A low-data-stage scheduler recommendation overrides the weighted choice.

allowDeepseek.description: Enables DeepSeek eligibility in unattended challenge mode after smoke validation has passed.

autoMergeWinner.description: Whether tend automatically sends the recommended challenge winner into the merge path and closes the loser. Defaults to false, which holds the winner for manual action while loser cleanup may still run after a decisive comparison.

gate.description: Challenge gate settings for tend merge controller race prevention.

coolOffSeconds.description: Seconds to hold a fresh wavemill task/* PR before allowing merge when no challenge pair signal exists. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 300 (5 minutes).

retryMaxAttempts.description: How many eval relaunch attempts to allow before marking the challenge eval path as failed to persist.

hardFailureRetryMaxAttempts.description: How many challenge eval hard-failure recovery attempts to allow before resolving the challenge pair as terminal. This is separate from soft eval relaunch retryMaxAttempts.

selectionHealth.description: Temporary challenge selection health. Adds TTL-bound in-flight model reservations and provider/model circuit breaking without mutating permanent disabled models. Set enabled=false as the rollback switch.

enabled.description: Whether challenge selection should honor temporary reservations and provider/model circuit state. Disable to restore legacy selector behavior while leaving state files ignored.

reservation.description: TTL settings for challenge challenger model reservations.

selectionTtlSeconds.description: Seconds a selected-but-not-launched challenge reservation excludes the same provider/model/stage from other planners.

inflightTtlSeconds.description: Seconds a launched challenge reservation remains active while waiting for a terminal outcome. Set to 0 to release on launch acknowledgement.

circuit.description: Temporary provider/model circuit breaker settings for typed transient upstream failures.

transientFailureThreshold.description: Provider-fault outcomes required inside windowSeconds before opening the provider/model circuit.

windowSeconds.description: Rolling window used to count transient provider failures.

cooldownSeconds.description: Seconds an open circuit blocks selection before allowing one half-open probe.

challengeScheduler.description: Challenge scheduling policy for exploration-driven model testing.

enabled.description: Enable advisory challenge recommendations during routing.

confidenceThreshold.description: Suggest a challenge when routing confidence falls below this threshold.

newModelChallengeCount.description: Treat models with fewer than this many eval records as new.

minEvalRecordsPerStage.description: Suggest a challenge when a workflow stage has fewer records than this threshold.

maxConcurrentChallenges.description: Advisory limit for how many challenges the orchestrator should run in parallel.

providers.description: Optional provider-specific execution paths for supported agent CLIs.

deepseek.description: Run Claude Code against DeepSeek's Anthropic-compatible endpoint. This path is default-off until explicitly enabled.

enabled.description: Enable DeepSeek as a Claude-compatible provider path.

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable name that holds the DeepSeek API key.

baseUrl.description: Anthropic-compatible base URL for Claude Code requests.

effortLevel.description: Claude Code effort level to request when using the DeepSeek provider path.

model.description: Default DeepSeek model for claude-deepseek launches.

subagentModel.description: Model for background subagent work (CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL). Defaults to model.

secretSource.description: Alternative env var name or secret source to resolve the DeepSeek API key. Falls back to apiKeyEnv / DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.

stateDir.description: Override the isolated Claude Code state directory used for claude-deepseek launches.

openrouter.description: Route launch-priority models through OpenRouter's API. Default-off until explicitly enabled.

enabled.description: Enable OpenRouter as a Claude-compatible provider path for launch-priority models.

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable name that holds the OpenRouter API key.

baseUrl.description: Anthropic-compatible base URL for Claude Code requests routed through OpenRouter.

contextWindowFloors.description: Optional per-stage context window floors (in tokens). A model whose declared contextWindowTokens is below the floor for a stage is excluded from selection for that stage. When a stage has no floor here, the built-in derived floor from shared/lib/model-registry.ts (STAGE_CONTEXT_WINDOW_FLOORS) is used; when neither is set, all models pass the check for that stage.

nativeAgent.description: Native-agent provider configuration resolved into Pi provider models.

enabled.description: Master toggle for native read-only agent routing. Defaults to disabled even when provider settings are present.

allowedPhases.description: Read-only workflow phases where native agents may be selected.

fallbackOnUnavailable.description: When true, task expansion falls back to the default Claude path if native prerequisites are unavailable.

planning.description: Planning-specific native-agent budgets and stagnation limits.

patchCoding.description: Explicit gate for native patch-coding alpha. Config alone is insufficient without certification.

certification.description: Native certification maintenance behavior used by mill startup preflight.

contextManagement.description: In-session native-agent context tracking, compaction, and packet budgeting controls.

ready.description: Settings for the ready stage (merge-readiness checks)

checks.description: List of check names to run (missing or empty uses conservative universal defaults: pr-exists, merge-conflict, ci-status)

requiredChecks.description: Checks that must pass for merge approval (subset of checks). Required checks that skip are non-blocking warnings.

requireCiChecks.description: Require at least one reported CI check before ready can pass. Set false only for repositories with no CI.

migrationKind.description: Declares migration format for migration-specific checks. Missing means migration-specific checks should skip unless explicitly supported.

migrationPatterns.description: Regex patterns used to identify migration files across the repository.

migrationChecks.description: Automatic migration-check discovery and base-refresh settings.

enabled.description: Enable automatic migration integrity checks when migration files are detected.

autoDetectAlembic.description: Auto-enable Alembic migration-chain checks when alembic/versions is present and ready.checks is empty.

baseRefresh.description: Refresh the base branch before local migration validation.

enabled.description: Fetch the base branch before migration validation.

timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for the pre-migration base refresh fetch.

migrationDangerLabels.description: Mapping of forbidden-DDL analyzer rule names to the PR label required to acknowledge that risk.

migrationForbiddenPatterns.description: Reserved repository-specific forbidden migration patterns for future ready-stage policy extensions.

transientRetryBudget.description: Number of transient post-PR CI failure observations to wait through before escalating to operator attention.

remediationLogMaxBytes.description: Maximum bytes of CI log evidence included in a ready remediation payload.

verificationGatingEnabled.description: Require a fresh controller-owned verification artifact after remediation pushes when the artifact protocol is present.

localCommandMap.description: Exact GitHub check/job name to local replay command mapping used for deterministic CI remediation.

remediation.description: Automatic remediation settings for fixable ready-check failures.

enabled.description: Launch a remediation agent when a fixable ready check fails.

maxAttempts.description: Maximum remediation launches allowed before ready falls back to operator attention.

agentCmd.description: Optional agent command override for ready remediation launches.

postPrReconciliation.description: Durable post-PR reconciliation capsule (HOK-2936). When enabled, ready remediation and merge-conflict recovery launch fresh agents from a persisted, validated capsule (stable foundation prefix + volatile incident suffix), record attempt telemetry, and invalidate the prior review verdict after any reconciliation commit. Default off during rollout.

enabled.description: Gate recovery launches on a validated reconciliation capsule and capsule-projected prompts.

paneRelease.description: Queue-owned task pane release (HOK-2937). When enabled with postPrReconciliation, reviewed merge-candidate tasks can release their tmux task pane after a durable capsule handoff and rehydrate only for bounded reconciliation. Default off during rollout.

enabled.description: Release eligible ready-stage task panes after a safe durable queue handoff.
Enable the ready watchdog during mill monitor ticks.

thresholdMinutes.description: Minutes without ready-stage progress before a task is classified as stale.

autoRecover.description: Allow safe local ready-state recovery when GitHub truth is clean and green.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum watchdog subprocess runtime per monitor tick.

stableFailureConsecutivePolls.description: Consecutive identical failing-check polls required before safe failures are treated as stable.

stableFailureEscalateAfterPolls.description: Consecutive identical failing-check polls required before unsafe failures escalate to operator attention.

safeRemediationCategories.description: Allowlisted failure categories that the watchdog may route into automatic remediation once stable.

mergeQueue.description: Queue settings for stale-main refresh and final merge-candidate promotion in mill ready flow.

enabled.description: Enable merge-lane semantics for ready PRs.

maxConcurrentCandidates.description: Maximum number of ready PRs that may actively refresh against the latest base at once.

stuckTimeoutSeconds.description: Demote a merge candidate after this many seconds without progress.

conflictGroupingEnabled.description: Use changed-file overlap groups to avoid promoting conflicting candidates together.

skipCooldownSeconds.description: Cooldown before a skipped candidate is eligible for immediate re-promotion.

monitor.description: Legacy monitor-specific settings kept for backwards-compatible aliases.

router.description: Settings for the prompt-to-model router that suggests the best LLM for a task based on historical eval data.

enabled.description: Enable model routing suggestions before workflow execution.

minRecords.description: Minimum total eval records required before the router makes suggestions.

minModels.description: Minimum distinct models with eval data before routing is active.

defaultAgent.description: Fallback agent CLI when router has insufficient data or no agentMap entry matches the recommended model.

mode.description: Routing strategy: 'heuristic' uses regex-based classification, 'llm' uses the DSPy-optimized selector, 'stage-aware' uses nearest-neighbor routing over live local evals plus fallback historical datasets, 'hokusai' calls the Hokusai API for ML-based routing, and 'auto' prefers Hokusai when configured before falling back to stage-aware and heuristic.

llmModel.description: Model to use for LLM-based routing decisions. Should be fast and cheap.

llmProvider.description: API provider for LLM routing calls. OpenAI recommended (gpt-4o-mini is fast and cheap).

kNeighbors.description: Number of nearest historical tasks to consider for stage-aware routing.

backfilledEvalsPath.description: Preferred supplemental backfilled eval dataset for the stage-aware router when local eval history is sparse.

stageBlendWeight.description: Regularization weight blending stage-specific scores with overall eval score during stage-aware routing.

enabled.description: Enable capability-aware candidate filtering inside Layer 3 policy and stage-aware routing.

exploration.description: Stochastic exploration for stage-aware and policy model selection. When enabled, per-stage picks are sampled from the top candidates instead of always taking the argmax, so newer or undersampled models keep receiving traffic.

enabled.description: Master toggle for exploration sampling. When false, routing is byte-identical to deterministic argmax selection.

mode.description: Sampling strategy: 'epsilon' picks a non-argmax candidate from the top-K window with probability 'rate'; 'softmax' samples the top-K window with probability proportional to exp(score / temperature).

rate.description: Per-stage exploration probability for epsilon mode.

temperature.description: Softmax temperature. Higher values flatten the distribution toward uniform sampling.

topK.description: Number of top-ranked candidates eligible for sampling per stage.

ucbConstant.description: UCB-style uncertainty bonus constant. Candidate ranking adds c * sqrt(ln(totalObservations + 1) / max(support, 1)) so undersampled models get a temporary boost that decays as evidence accumulates. 0 disables the bonus.

priors.description: Registry-prior blending and candidate seeding for stage-aware routing. Seeds every eligible stage model into the candidate set (even with zero eval records) and blends empirical KNN scores with registry quality-score priors.

enabled.description: Enable prior blending and zero-record candidate seeding.

blendSamples.description: Records needed before a model's score is fully empirical. Blend weight is min(support / blendSamples, 1); zero records means pure registry prior.

newModelBoost.description: Recency-aware exploration boost. Models whose registry releasedAt falls inside the window get a selection-probability multiplier during exploration sampling, decaying linearly to 1.0 at the window edge. Long-term ranking always comes from accumulated evals.

windowDays.description: Days after releasedAt during which a model counts as recent. Also used by the challenge scheduler to prioritize recent under-covered models.

multiplier.description: Sampling-weight multiplier at release time. 1 disables the sampling boost (scheduler recency prioritization still applies).

coverage.description: Per-model-per-stage coverage targets for the diversity report (tools/router-diversity-report.ts).

minRecordsPerModelStage.description: Eval records each model should accumulate per workflow stage. Cells below this target are flagged in the diversity report.

maxStageShare.description: Dominance threshold: warn when a single model exceeds this share of any stage over the report window.

window.description: Number of most recent eval records used for stage-share and routing-mode breakdowns.

escalation.description: Escalate risky or low-confidence routes to stronger coder candidates when budget allows.

enabled.description: Enable post-selection escalation for low expected success or low routing confidence.

expectedSuccessFloor.description: Escalate when expectedSuccess is below this floor. Equal values do not trigger.

confidenceFloor.description: Escalate when routing confidence is below this floor. Equal values do not trigger.

minCoderClassRankIncrease.description: Minimum model-class rank increase preferred for coder escalation. Same-class higher ladder positions remain eligible.

hokusai.description: Hokusai API configuration for ML-based workflow routing. Hokusai is only available via API.

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable name that holds the Hokusai bearer token. Falls back to HOKUSAI_API_TOKEN when omitted.

difficulty.description: Settings for the task difficulty classifier that enforces model quality floors before routing.

enabled.description: Enable difficulty-based model floor enforcement.

classifierModel.description: Model used for LLM-based task classification (defaults to cheapest available).

cacheTtlDays.description: Number of days to cache difficulty classification results.

skipLlm.description: Use heuristic classification only (skip LLM call). Useful for offline or cost-sensitive environments.

validation.description: Settings for task packet validation (quality gate after issue expansion).

enabled.description: Whether validation is enabled. Can be bypassed per-expansion with --skip-validation flag.
Whether Layer 1 validation is enabled.
Whether Layer 2 validation is enabled.

model.description: Model selector to use for task packet review. Accepts a family alias such as 'haiku', 'inherit', or a pinned model ID such as 'gpt-5.6-terra'. Should be fast and cheap.

provider.description: LLM provider for Layer 2 validation. 'claude-cli' uses local Claude subscription, 'anthropic' uses Anthropic API key, 'codex' uses the Codex CLI.

onFailure.description: Behavior when validation fails: 'conservative' (skip update), 'auto-fix' (retry expansion with feedback), 'proceed' (update anyway with warnings attached).

prePrVerification.description: CI-derived, controller-owned pre-PR verification gate. Runs locally-reproducible CI checks before review/PR creation, discovered from GitHub branch protection and executed through explicit, audited recipe commands.

enabled.description: Master toggle for pre-PR verification. When false (default), the gate is disabled and all PRs proceed without local verification.

required.description: When true, a passing verification artifact is mandatory before PR creation. When false, verification runs but failures do not block PR creation.

source.description: Source for discovering required checks: 'github-enforced' queries GitHub branch protection and rulesets; 'explicit' uses the configured recipe without discovery.

requiredChecks.description: Check names to discover from GitHub when source is 'github-enforced'. Ignored when source is 'explicit'. Example: ['Shell and Unit Tests', 'Type Check']

recipe.description: Ordered list of shell commands to execute for verification.

commands.description: Ordered list of shell commands to run. Each command is executed sequentially; if any fails, verification stops and fails overall. Example: ['npx tsx tools/check-pi-version.ts', 'npm test']

timeoutSeconds.description: Per-command timeout in seconds. Commands exceeding this timeout are marked as timeout failures.

enabled.description: Enable automatic retry on transient failures.

maxAttempts.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for each command.

backoffSeconds.description: Seconds to wait between retry attempts.

remoteOnlyExceptions.description: Enforced GitHub checks that intentionally have no safe local equivalent. Each entry requires a rationale and should remain enforced in remote CI.

reason.description: Maintainer rationale for why this check cannot safely run locally.

acknowledgedBy.description: Maintainer or team that acknowledged the remote-only exception.

nonEnforcedJobs.description: Local workflow job names intentionally excluded from CI-to-local drift coverage, such as aggregators or PR-context-only gate jobs. Prefer remoteOnlyExceptions when the job is also an enforced check.

driftValidation.description: Controls CI-to-local verification contract drift validation.

enabled.description: Enable drift validation for github-enforced pre-PR verification.

blockOnUnmapped.description: When true, unmapped enforced checks are treated as blocking validation errors.

warnOnDrift.description: Show drift warnings during diagnostics and initialization.

autoAcknowledgeThreshold.description: Confidence threshold for proposing mappings as safe candidates. Proposals are not applied automatically.

mappingAcknowledgements.description: Explicit maintainer-reviewed mappings from enforced GitHub check names to local recipe commands and optional workflow provenance.

checks.description: Map exact GitHub check names to local recipe commands or mapping metadata.

logCaptureLines.description: Number of lines to capture from the start and end of command output for bounded log storage. Full logs are stored separately.

draftFallback.description: When true, allow draft PR creation if verification fails deterministically. When false, test failures block all PR creation (fail-closed).

staleTtlSeconds.description: Seconds until a verification artifact is considered stale. Stale artifacts trigger re-verification before PR creation.

compatibility.description: Backward-compatibility mode for repos without configured recipes.

mode.description: 'allow': gate passes silently for unconfigured repos (backward compatible). 'warn': gate passes but logs migration warning. 'block': gate fails for unconfigured repos (strict mode).

warnAfterDays.description: Days between migration warnings in 'warn' mode (prevents spam).

constraints.description: Settings for constraint validation (promoting rules from prose to code).

enabled.description: Enable constraint validation. When true (default), generated constraint rules are validated before PR creation.

cleanupAfterMerge.description: Automatically delete constraint rules after PR merge. When false (default), rules persist for audit trail.

cleanup.description: Settings for durable cleanup episodes, retry scheduling, and branch deletion authority (HOK-2957 staged rollout).

enabled.description: Persist terminal cleanup episodes and skip unchanged retained evidence.

maxAttempts.description: Maximum cleanup attempts for retryable cleanup failures before needs-user.

backoffBaseSeconds.description: Initial cleanup retry backoff in seconds.

backoffCapSeconds.description: Maximum cleanup retry backoff in seconds.

jitterRatio.description: Deterministic jitter ratio applied to cleanup retry backoff.

prAwareCleanup.description: PR-aware deletion authority (HOK-2953/HOK-2957). Disabling skips the safe_terminal_pr_head classification while every other cleanup path is unchanged; affected branches fall back to retention with evidence. The WAVEMILL_PR_AWARE_CLEANUP=0 env var still overrides this to disabled.

enabled.description: Consult PR terminal evidence to authorize deleting task branches whose local head matches the merged PR headRefOid.

branchDeletion.description: Staged-rollout gate for destructive task-branch deletion (HOK-2957). Applied at the classification->mutation boundary in safe_remove_task_worktree_and_branch: classification, decision records, and the shadow ledger always execute; destructive git mutations only run when mode=enforce. The WAVEMILL_BRANCH_DELETION_MODE env var overrides this key.

mode.description: off: never delete, do not record shadow ledger; shadow (default during rollout): record every proposed decision and evidence bundle without deleting; enforce: full behavior including destructive git mutations. Defaults off during shadow rollout per HOK-2957.

ledgerPath.description: Append-only JSONL ledger of proposed cleanup decisions in shadow/enforce mode.

ui.description: Settings for UI review and design artifact analysis.

devServer.description: Dev server URL for screenshot capture (e.g. http://localhost:3000). Used by frontend-testing skill and UI review tools.

visualVerification.description: Enable screenshot capture and console checking during UI review.

designStandards.description: Enable design artifact discovery and compliance checking. When enabled, review context will include Tailwind config, component libraries, design guides, etc.

creativeDirection.description: Enable creative design review (opt-in, uses frontend-design skill to evaluate aesthetic quality and uniqueness).

review.description: Settings for the self-review loop in workflow commands.

maxIterations.description: Maximum number of self-review iterations before escalating to human. The agent will attempt to fix issues and re-review up to this many times.

enabled.description: Enable the self-review loop in workflow commands. When false, workflow proceeds directly from implementation to validation.

metricsLog.description: Path to review metrics log file (JSONL format). Relative paths resolve against repo root. Tracks iteration count, findings, and outcomes for each review run.

personas.description: Active reviewer personas for code review. Each persona focuses on specific concerns. The 'design' persona requires ui.creativeDirection: true to be enabled.

reviewMerge.description: Deterministic guards that prevent review and merge flows from silently reverting changes from other recently merged PRs.

enabled.description: When true, detect and block unacknowledged deletions of files introduced by other recent PRs on the integration branch.

maxRecentMerges.description: Maximum number of recent first-parent integration commits to scan for cross-PR revert detection.

integration.description: Settings for autonomous integration mode (opt-in). Task branches are promoted to an integration branch before merging to main.

enabled.description: Enable autonomous integration mode. When false (default), the integration controller is a no-op.

integrationBranch.description: The long-lived integration branch where task branches are merged before promotion to main.

promotionBranch.description: The target branch for promotion after integration validation passes.

autoUpdatePromotionBranch.description: When true, Wavemill may merge the latest remote promotion branch into the integration branch before promotion, but only when conflict prediction says the update is clean.

mergeMethod.description: Merge strategy for promoting the integration branch to the promotion branch.

deleteBranchAfterMerge.description: Delete task branches after they are merged into the integration branch.

haltOnRed.description: Halt integration promotion when CI checks are failing on the integration branch.

requiredChecks.description: Named PR checks that must be reported and passing before Wavemill merges a task PR or reports a promotion PR as green.

highRiskPolicy.description: Policy for handling high-risk PRs: 'block' prevents merge, 'manual' requires human approval, 'allow' permits autonomous merge.

useMillSession.description: When true, the integration controller reuses the active mill tmux session for status reporting.

mergeLockTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes after which another tend process may reclaim a wm:merging merge-lane lock as stale (measured from the label's most recent application on GitHub). 0 disables expiry. Must exceed the worst-case legitimate merge duration (rebase + 30 min check wait + 5 min merge retry window, roughly 40 minutes).

readyPolicy.description: Eligibility guards for the autonomous merge controller

promotion.description: Settings for how wavemill promote behaves when squash-snapshot reconciliation would need to mutate a protected integration branch.

protectedIntegrationStrategy.description: Fallback strategy when promotion detects that reconciling the integration branch would require updating a protected branch. skip-reconciliation keeps the direct promotion PR, block stops with manual guidance, and use-promotion-head pushes a dedicated transport branch instead.

promotionHeadBranch.description: Dedicated branch used as the PR head when protectedIntegrationStrategy is use-promotion-head.

permissions.description: Permission settings for agent tool usage. Configures which commands can be auto-approved without user confirmation.

autoApprovePatterns.description: Command patterns that are auto-approved without user confirmation. Supports glob patterns (e.g., 'git status*', 'gh pr view*'). Patterns are matched against the full command string.

worktreeMode.description: Special permission settings when working in isolated git worktrees.

enabled.description: Enable relaxed permissions when running in a git worktree. When true, read-only commands are more likely to be auto-approved.

autoApproveReadOnly.description: Auto-approve read-only commands in worktrees without user confirmation. Only applies when worktreeMode.enabled is true.

quota.description: Configuration for proactive model quota health detection and manual status overrides.

manualOverrides.description: Manual status overrides per model (e.g. set sonnet degrading during known high-usage windows).

expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 date/time when this manual override expires.

thresholds.description: Tunable thresholds for proactive quota degradation heuristics.

volumeThresholdPercent.description: Percent of baseline rolling request volume (5-minute window) that triggers degrading.

budgetThresholdPercent.description: Remaining budget percentage threshold for proactive degrading.

nearLimitCount.description: Number of near-limit warning signals inside the decay window before marking degrading.

verification.description: Verification settings for weak model fallback. Automatically enforces extra checks when weaker models generate code.

enabled.description: Enable verification engine. When false, all verification is skipped.

qualityThresholds.description: Quality score thresholds per task type. Models scoring below threshold trigger verification.

coding.description: Threshold for coding tasks. Haiku (60) triggers verification, Sonnet (90) does not.

patchSizeCap.description: Patch size cap settings. Enforced when weak model is used and no stronger reviewer is available.

baseLines.description: Base line count for patch size cap. Adjusted by quality gap if adjustByQualityGap is true.

adjustByQualityGap.description: Whether to adjust cap based on quality gap. Formula: cap = baseLines * max(0.5, 1 - (gap / 50))

mandatoryChecks.description: Checks that must pass before commit when verification is triggered.

selfExplanation.description: Require structured commit message with CHANGED/WHY/RISK sections.

secondPassReview.description: Second-pass review settings. Triggered when weak model is used and stronger reviewer is available.

riskPatterns.description: File path patterns that indicate high-risk code requiring second-pass review.

budget.description: Cost budget constraints per operating mode. Used by the router to enforce spending limits.

normalMode.description: Per-task cost budget in USD for normal mode. Default: 25.00

constrainedMode.description: Per-task cost budget in USD for constrained mode. Default: 15.00

survivalMode.description: Per-task cost budget in USD for survival mode. Default: 5.00

retry.description: Per-bucket tuning for the shared bounded-retry helper (shared/lib/bounded-retry.sh, HOK-2924). Keys are bucket slugs (e.g. phase-launch-coding, ready-remediation, pending-ready-recheck, failed-ready-recheck, challenge-eval-soft, challenge-eval-hard). Env vars (WAVEMILL_RETRY_BACKOFF_<BUCKET>_{BASE,CAP}_SECONDS) take precedence at runtime. Existing ceilings (ready.remediation.maxAttempts, challenge.eval.retryMaxAttempts, challenge.eval.hardFailureRetryMaxAttempts) remain the effective source for their buckets.

base.description: Backoff base in seconds before the second attempt (doubles each attempt).

maxAttempts.description: Attempt ceiling before the path terminalizes with a recorded reason.

safety.description: Runtime safety controls including secret redaction.

secretEnvNames.description: Env-var names whose values must be redacted as literal strings from files, output, payloads, and comments.
